title: Uniqueness of normalized self-Tor comparison
statement: For every commutative ring A, ideal I and natural number n, any two A-linear morphisms from [new-r4-conormal-exterior-module] to Tor_n^A(A/I,A/I) satisfying [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-predicate] are equal.

source.place: comparison of free complexes with resolutions, followed by exterior generation

proof.text: Lift each conormal entry to I. The Koszul complex on the resulting tuple has free terms. Lift its quotient augmentation to a projective resolution degree by degree using projectivity and exactness (Tag 00LS). After tensoring by A/I its differentials vanish, so the standard wedge defines a cycle.

Apply both normalization hypotheses to the same tuple, lift and cycle, and cancel the resolution isomorphism. Pure wedges span over A/I; surjectivity of A -> A/I converts their scalar multiples into A-scalar multiples, on which A-linearity propagates equality. Degree zero uses the empty tuple and its unit wedge.
